chapter_mission: Aidel Saxan is assassinated and Thrackan Sal-Solo installed as Governor-General of Corellia. Brooks First Pinch point lands.
chapter_turn: The Corellian war acquires a face who is Han Solo's blood relation; diplomatic options collapse overnight.

scene_plan.purpose: Saxan's last scene — a brief exchange before the off-page assassination.
Thrackan's installation and public address — the war acquires its face.

exit_vector: Thrackan addressing Corellia on a live feed as the book's new antagonist-in-residence.
notes: Assassination is off-page for the reader; the consequences are foregrounded. First Pinch lands without histrionic violence.
